name: devloop
description: AI-native SDLC loop as committed artifacts, for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Shared development workflow skills for Claude Code and Codex. Start work resolves an issue or task, prepares a branch and plan, and begins implementation. Deep review examines PRs and branches for correctness and accidental complexity, then proposes minimal fixes without editing files. Adopt installs devloop's engineering patterns into a project's AGENTS.md and keeps them current on re-run.
defaultPrompt: Use start-work to begin implementing a task.
Use deep-review to review the current branch.
Use adopt to install devloop's engineering patterns into this project.
